title: 第6章 爷对豆芽菜没兴趣

content_zh:
夏侯擎天扫了眼柳昇，怎么看怎么觉得他在幸灾乐祸。
淡定个屁！
夏侯擎天字典里就没有“淡定”这个词。
资料上说玉绯烟爱慕玉四皇子夏侯楠，天天像花痴一样追在他身后，惹恼了玉芝兰，最后引来杀身之祸……这样的脑残不可能是他看上的小野猫！
完全不可能！
“资料弄错了。”夏侯擎天声音有些僵硬。
“王爷，青鸿出手，从不出错。”
柳昇笑着，一瓢凉水把夏侯擎天浇了个透心凉。
“玉老爷子和玉星穹打了胜仗，不日就要回朝。听说玉惊雷最疼爱的就是小孙女玉绯烟，玉星穹也对这个胞妹宠爱有加……王爷，还是把绯烟小姐送回去吧！”
“老子说错了就是错了！”夏侯擎天猛地站起来，身下的椅子四分五裂。
他挑中的人，绝对不是那个什么玉绯烟！
“柳昇，管好你的嘴。外面要是传出一丁点儿消息，爷就把你绑去给杜五姑娘当压寨相公——”
“别！王爷，不带这么欺负人的！”
等柳昇追出去，夏侯擎天已经运了轻功，早就消失得无影无踪。柳昇合拢了手中的玉扇，眼里精光闪闪。
玉绯烟，呵，有点儿意思！
夏侯擎天步履有些沉重，等他进屋，撩开帘子，看到玉绯烟那张微微泛红的小脸，心情才渐渐平复了下来。
“猫儿，你不是那个玉绯烟，对不对？”夏侯擎天坐在床边，手指按压在玉绯烟柔软的嘴唇上。
触感真好！
回想起玉绯烟中毒之后还毅然护着自己后背的那股子倔强，夏侯擎天慢慢的俯下身，凑到玉绯烟面前，在她粉紫色的唇上略带惩罚性地轻咬着，只等小人儿呼吸急促才缓缓松开。
看着玉绯烟泛着水润光泽略微红肿的唇，夏侯擎天面颊发烫，耳尖变成胭脂色，神情带着几分青涩的腼腆，过了好一会儿才变得正常。

不管你是谁，你以后就是爷的猫儿了！
看着昏睡不醒的玉绯烟，夏侯擎天目光深邃，声音逐渐低沉。
“他们害你，爷便护着你；他们说你是废物，爷就把你打造成天下无敌。”
“不过，爷的好处不能白拿，日后你便是爷的猫儿。”
“爷让你上树掏鸟，你不能下河捉鱼，对爷要百分之两百的忠心。还有，不能再犯花痴！夏侯楠那个小白脸有爷俊么？再念着他，爷就打你个屁股开花！”
仔细想了想，没有什么要交代的，夏侯擎天抓起玉绯烟的手，小指和她的小指勾了起来。
“爷一诺千金，你不反对爷就当你答应了。”
“你放心，爷会你报仇！西越的那帮余孽竟然伤了爷的猫儿，爷去扒了他们的皮！还有四海阁，也没存在的必要了！”
“至于忠义侯府的那些腌臜货，等你好了，爷留着给你练手！爷的人若是连几只蛆虫都碾不死，就没必要呆爷身边了！这也算是，爷对你的考验吧！”
想到玉绯烟身上的鞭伤是拜玉芝兰所赐，夏侯擎天张口咬在玉绯烟左手虎口处。
居然为了一个小白脸将自己陷入那样的境地，真是活该！
虽然心里这么骂着，夏侯擎天最后还是松了口，又舔了舔白净小手上的嫣红牙印，算是惩罚之后的安抚。
夏侯擎天自信满满，直接将玉绯烟归打上了“私有物”的烙印。其他的事儿，比如玉绯烟和夏侯楠的婚约，他压根儿都没放在眼里。
连南疆西越国固若金汤的城池他都能给拆了，还怕拆不散他们？
捏着玉绯烟粉嫩的小脸，夏侯擎天笑得恶劣。
侄媳妇……呵，他没承认，谁敢应下！
一年一度的云雾围场狩猎，因为西越国刺客的出现被打断。大周国皇上夏侯君宇一边让人追查刺客下落，一边打道回京。
只等到了京城，才有人上报，说忠义侯府的嫡女，未来的四皇子妃玉绯烟下落不明。
玉千寻的妾室南山夫人眼泪汪汪地跪在皇宫里磕头请罪，夏侯君宇第一时间派出了禁卫军原路返回，寻找玉绯烟的下落，还挂出悬赏，赏银甚至高达万两白银。
玉绯烟失踪的消息一经传出，有人欢喜有人愁，更多人给此事披上了阴谋的外衣。

毕竟玉惊雷和玉星穹打了胜仗，等他们祖孙回朝，必定会得到皇上的重用，和玉绯烟有婚约的四皇子则是这场联姻中最大的受益人。

content_en:
Xiahou Qingtian glanced at Liu Sheng, feeling that he was gloating about his misfortune.
Calm down your ass!
The word "calm" does not exist in Xiahou Qingtian's dictionary.
According to the information, Yu Feiyan was in love with the fourth prince of Yu, Xia Hounan, and chased after him like a nympho every day, which annoyed Yu Zhilan and eventually led to her death... Such a brainless person could not be the little wild cat he fell in love with!
Totally impossible!
"The information is wrong." Xiahou Qingtian's voice was a little stiff.
"My lord, Qinghong never makes a mistake when he takes action."
Liu Sheng smiled and poured a ladle of cold water over Xiahou Qingtian.
"Mr. Yu has won the battle with Yu Xingqiong and will return to the court soon. I heard that the one Yu Jinglei loves the most is his granddaughter Yu Feiyan, and Yu Xingqiong also loves this sister very much... Your lord, please send Miss Feiyan back!"
"What I said is wrong is wrong!" Xiahou Qingtian stood up suddenly, and the chair under him fell into pieces.
The person he picked was definitely not that Jade Feiyan!
"Liu Sheng, keep your mouth shut. If there is any news outside, I will kidnap you and give you to Miss Du Wu to be the village's mistress——"
"No! Your Majesty, don't bully people like this!"
By the time Liu Sheng chased him out, Xiahou Qingtian had already used Qing Gong and had long since disappeared without a trace. Liu Sheng closed the jade fan in his hand, his eyes sparkling.
Jade Feiyan, haha, it’s interesting!
Xiahou Qingtian's steps were a little heavy. When he entered the room, opened the curtain, and saw Yu Feiyan's slightly red face, his mood gradually calmed down.
"Mao'er, you're not that Yu Feiyan, are you?" Xiahou Qingtian sat on the edge of the bed, pressing his fingers on Yu Feiyan's soft lips.
What a nice touch!
Recalling Yu Feiyan's stubbornness in protecting his back even after being poisoned, Xia Hou Qingtian slowly leaned down in front of Yu Feiyan, biting her pink and purple lips punitively, and only slowly let go after the little person's breathing became rapid.
Looking at Yu Feiyan's slightly red and swollen lips, Xiahou Qingtian's cheeks were hot, the tips of his ears turned rouge, and his expression was a bit green and shy. It took him a while to become normal.
No matter who you are, you will be my cat from now on!
Looking at the sleepy Yu Feiyan, Xiahou Qingtian's eyes were deep and his voice gradually became lower.
"If they harm you, I will protect you; if they say you are useless, I will make you invincible."
"However, my benefits cannot be taken in vain. From now on, you will be my cat."
"I asked you to go up the tree to catch birds, but you can't go down the river to catch fish. You must be 200% loyal to me. Also, don't be a nymphomaniac again! Is that pretty boy Xia Hounan as handsome as me? If you miss him again, I will spank you and make you bloom!"
After thinking about it carefully, he found that he had nothing to explain. Xiahou Qingtian grabbed Yu Feiyan's hand and hooked his little finger with hers.
"I promise you a thousand pieces of gold. If you don't object, I will treat it as your agreement."
"Don't worry, I will take revenge on you! Those remnants of Xiyue actually hurt my cat, so I went to skin them! There is no need for the Sihai Pavilion to exist anymore!"
"As for those bastards in the Zhongyi Hou Mansion, I will keep them for you to practice when you are better! If my people can't crush a few maggots to death, there is no need to stay with me! This can be regarded as my test for you!"
Thinking that the whiplash on Yu Feiyan's body was given by Yu Zhilan, Xiahou Qingtian opened his mouth and bit the tiger's mouth of Yu Feiyan's left hand.
You actually put yourself in that situation for a pretty boy, you really deserve it!
Although he was cursing in his heart, Xiahou Qingtian finally relaxed and licked the bright red tooth marks on his white little hands, which was considered as comfort after the punishment.
Xiahou Qingtian was so confident that he directly labeled Yu Fei Yangui as "private property". He didn't pay attention to other things, such as the engagement between Yu Feiyan and Xia Hounan.
He can even demolish the impregnable cities of Xiyue Kingdom in southern Xinjiang.Are you worried that you can't break them up?
Holding Yu Feiyan's pink face, Xiahou Qingtian smiled evilly.
Niece-in-law... Hehe, he didn't admit it, who dares to accept it!
The annual hunt in the Yunwu Paddock was interrupted by the appearance of the Xiyue Kingdom assassin. Emperor Xiahou Junyu of the Great Zhou Kingdom made his way back to Beijing while asking people to track down the assassin's whereabouts.
Only when they arrived in the capital did someone report that the whereabouts of Yu Feiyan, the legitimate daughter of the Zhongyi Hou Mansion and the future fourth prince's concubine, were missing.
Mrs. Nanshan, Yu Qianxun's concubine, knelt down in the palace with tears in her eyes and kowtowed to plead guilty. Xiahou Junyu immediately sent the Imperial Guard back the way they came to look for Yu Feiyan's whereabouts, and even put up a reward of up to 10,000 taels of silver.
As soon as the news of Yu Feiyan's disappearance came out, some people were happy and some were worried, and even more people put the matter under the cloak of conspiracy.
After all, Yu Jinglei and Yu Xingqiong won the battle, and when their ancestors and grandchildren returned to the court, they would definitely be favored by the emperor. The fourth prince who was engaged to Yu Feiyan was the biggest beneficiary of this marriage.
